justification: OC-17 failed on DQ-33 (66 Warringah rules on Part heading pages applied to every development type by fallback) and on the published council list (Ashfield, Marrickville pass but were not listed). Each heading-page row was given its Part by where its text sits relative to the 13.5pt 'Part X' heading on the page (backup data/db_rollback_backups/nb66_part_pre_2026-10-16.json); the retag now passes v2_dcp_part to the tagger exactly as enrichment/pipeline.py already does, so a retag no longer undoes the publish. 4 rows on p259 sat above the Part H heading, i.e. the end of Part G (withheld area), and are withheld too.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any OC-17 sub-check fails, or the published council list differs from the computed one in either direction
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-16 before: 'FAIL DQ-33' (count 66) and 'scoped-council list does not match: passes but not published: ashfield ... marrickville'. After: 'OC-17: HOLDS'; DQ-33 count 0.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Warringah DCP 2011 PDF: Part headings (13.5pt 'Part A'..'Part H' at pages 3,15,27,37,66,90,94,259) and each row's text position on its page

one column added to an existing SELECT and passed to an existing tagger argument; real-layer check is the script's own dry run against production (VALUES change 4, SERVED ROWS NARROWED 0)

pre_impl.existing_data: northern_beaches_part_pages.json leaves heading pages unresolved by design; tagger already accepts part as fallback (Waverley, 2026-10-15)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: assumed the retag read v2_dcp_part; it did not, unlike the publish pipeline
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: no new code path; one argument passed

functions.if_none: a row with no Part behaves exactly as before

values.value: DQ-33 66 -> 0; retag dry run VALUES change 4, NARROWED 0

break_it.how: Parts set only on 66 heading-page rows, each by measured text position against the heading (none unresolved); retag refuses any narrowing (--expect-narrowings 0)
break_it.repro: retag dry run prints SERVED ROWS NARROWED 0

break_it.what_happens: tags change for other councils without anyone reviewing them

break_it.scenario: the council list drifts after a later publish
break_it.what_happens: the site names a council that no longer passes
break_it.how: OC-17 recomputes the list from the database and fails on any difference

mutation_analysis: Dropping part=dcp_part restores 66 no_config in the NB dry run.
residual_risk: Part assignment by text position was a one-off write; a re-extraction of Warringah would need the same resolution again (the part_pages map still leaves heading pages unresolved).
